discovery_notes: Search-snippet leads only; 30 standard searches. Follow-up 2 of B041, first coverage of Asia 2023-2024. Mainly Disney Pins Blog, WDWNT, TDR Explorer. Reseller-only items (usshoppingsos, k23japan, castleplanethk, fryguypins) held. Pin records only where a snippet names each pin; packs with only a character list held per rule 12. 'Pin badge' is TDR's term for pin.
